title.zh-TW: 鍵盤操作、外掛授權與記憶體修復
title.zh-CN: 键盘操作、插件授权与内存修复
title.en: Keybindings, plugin authorization, and memory fixes
title.ja: キーバインド、プラグイン認証、メモリ修正
title.ko: 키 바인딩, 플러그인 인증 및 메모리 수정

body.zh-TW: 新增 readline 鍵盤風格、外掛市集動態授權與自架 Runner 控制，修正長工作階段記憶體成長、輸出風格漂移、提示建議及多項代理與介面問題。
body.zh-CN: 新增 readline 键盘风格、插件市场动态授权与自托管 Runner 控制，修复长会话内存增长、输出风格漂移、提示建议及多项代理与界面问题。
body.en: Adds readline keybindings, dynamic plugin-marketplace authorization, and self-hosted runner controls, while fixing long-session memory growth, style drift, prompt suggestions, agents, and UI issues.
body.ja: readline キー操作、プラグイン市場の動的認証、セルフホスト Runner 制御を追加し、長時間セッションのメモリ増加、出力スタイルのずれ、候補表示、エージェント、UI の問題を修正しました。
body.ko: readline 키 바인딩, 플러그인 마켓 동적 인증, 자체 호스팅 러너 제어를 추가하고 장기 세션 메모리 증가, 출력 스타일 변동, 프롬프트 제안, 에이전트 및 UI 문제를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
Added a `keybindingFlavor` setting: set it to `"readline"` to make Ctrl+W in the prompt delete back to the previous whitespace, as in Bash; the default (`"classic"`) is unchanged
Plugin marketplaces: `headersHelper` on a url marketplace or a catalog entry runs a command that mints HTTP headers (e.g. a short-lived token) for catalog and same-origin archive fetches
A catalog entry's `headersHelper` runs only when you install or update that plugin, after its command is shown; `claude plugin install/update` ask `[y/N]` (or pass `-y`)
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>`: on SIGTERM, keep serving attached sessions, park what is left after that many minutes, then exit
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-command` / `--proxy-authorization-file` for egress proxies that require a freshly issued `Proxy-Authorization` header on every connection
Fixed unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions: subagent tool results are now released once they leave the recent display window
Fixed custom, project, and plugin output styles drifting back to the default voice mid-session
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=true` not keeping prompt suggestions on when your account is near, but not over, its usage limit
Fixed worktree-isolation Bash refusals telling you to remove a redirect when the command had none
Fixed self-hosted runners occasionally being removed by the server after a single slow or lost poll request, handing their healthy session to another runner
Fixed MCP elicitation dialogs showing nothing for URLs longer than 4,096 characters, and permission prompts dropping the "don't ask again" option when the project path didn't fit the terminal width
Fixed leftover `/tmp/claude-*-cwd` files when a Bash command is killed, times out, or is interrupted
Fixed held Backspace being ignored on terminals that send Ctrl+H for Backspace when keystrokes arrive in large bursts (slow SSH/mosh links)
Fixed text-wrapping in permission prompt diffs: lines containing wide multi-code-point characters (such as emoji) or tabs are no longer clipped
Fixed killing a suspended (Ctrl+Z) session sometimes leaving the terminal in bracketed-paste mode with the cursor hidden
Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving a `server/discover` request before `initialize`, forcing lazy servers to start their backend on every session open
Fixed a proxy's refusal of a connection being reported as a generic network error instead of naming the proxy
Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache-miss warning appearing when the prompt cache had already expired
Fixed per-task Stop from the Remote Control tasks panel doing nothing on CLI-hosted sessions
Fixed remote sessions exiting when a client delivered a user message without a valid role
Fixed Remote Control sessions started by `claude remote-control` inheriting session-scoped environment variables from the launching shell
Fixed a Remote Control session whose process crashed staying unavailable until `claude remote-control` was restarted; it can now be reused when you next message it
Fixed Remote Control messages sent from the web or Desktop while Claude is mid-turn disappearing from the transcript after the turn finishes
Fixed Remote Control model picks made on a phone or web not updating the model shown in the terminal
Fixed Remote Control disconnecting with "login expired" when a brief network hiccup delays renewing your sign-in; it now retries and stays connected
Fixed Remote Control reporting a failed reconnect on sign-out; signing out now ends the session with a clear message
Fixed `ListAgents`/`SendMessage` reporting "Remote Control is not connected" in sessions run by `claude remote-control` (server mode) or Desktop/IDE hosts; they now list and reach Remote Control peers
Fixed `ListAgents` and `SendMessage` exposing the idle worker that the agent view pre-warms for your next background session; it now appears only once a task claims it
Cross-session messaging: sending to a session on this machine that refuses inbound messages (e.g. `crossSessionInbound: "refuse"`) now reports "refused" to the sender instead of a silent success
Cross-session messaging: a session whose inbox drops your messages (rate limit or full queue) now tells your session, instead of the messages vanishing silently
Improved startup: bare `claude` starts sooner on macOS
Improved Bash tool permission checking for zsh-specific syntax in shell conditionals
Improved Remote Control connection resilience: brief HTTP 403 refusals from a network edge, VPN, or proxy are now tolerated for up to 3 minutes, with the refusing party named when a block persists
Improved startup responsiveness: the automatic update check now runs about 10 seconds after launch instead of competing with startup for CPU
Updated the bundled `claude-api` skill for the Managed Agents Aug 19 release: web search/fetch domain settings and memory stores on self-hosted sandboxes
Changed Ctrl+L and Cmd+K in fullscreen to always just repaint — the double-press `/clear` shortcut was removed, and 1-row nvim terminals no longer trigger automatic `/clear` loops
Changed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` to show disabled servers as `⊘ Disabled` instead of connecting to them for a health check
MCP `headersHelper` in a project `.mcp.json`, and inline MCP servers in project or `--add-dir` agent files, now require that folder's trust dialog to have been accepted (also under `claude -p`)
MCP `headersHelper` from a project `.mcp.json`, plugin, or agent file runs without inherited credential env vars; user, managed and claude.ai-scope helpers now run from the Claude config dir

title.zh-TW: 提示快取與精簡輸出模式
title.zh-CN: 提示缓存与精简输出模式
title.en: Prompt caching and concise output
title.ja: プロンプトキャッシュと簡潔な出力
title.ko: 프롬프트 캐싱 및 간결한 출력

body.zh-TW: 修正使用 LLM gateway 或自訂 Base URL 時的提示快取，並新增內建 Concise 輸出風格，直接先給結果、減少前言。
body.zh-CN: 修复使用 LLM gateway 或自定义 Base URL 时的提示缓存，并新增内置 Concise 输出风格，直接先给结果、减少前言。
body.en: Fixes prompt caching with LLM gateways or custom base URLs and adds a built-in Concise style that leads with results and reduces preamble.
body.ja: LLM ゲートウェイやカスタム Base URL でのプロンプトキャッシュを修正し、結果を先に示して前置きを減らす Concise スタイルを追加しました。
body.ko: LLM 게이트웨이 또는 사용자 지정 Base URL의 프롬프트 캐싱을 수정하고 결과를 먼저 제시하며 서문을 줄이는 Concise 스타일을 추가했습니다.

items.original:
Fixed prompt caching for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL
Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.

title.zh-TW: 預設模型、跨工作階段通知與沙箱修復
title.zh-CN: 默认模型、跨会话通知与沙箱修复
title.en: Default model, cross-session notices, and sandbox fixes
title.ja: 既定モデル、セッション間通知、サンドボックス修正
title.ko: 기본 모델, 세션 간 알림 및 샌드박스 수정

body.zh-TW: 新增預設模型環境變數與跨工作階段閒置通知，強化 macOS 沙箱拒絕規則，並修正目錄刪除、全螢幕、模型選單、子程序及多項工作階段問題。
body.zh-CN: 新增默认模型环境变量与跨会话空闲通知，强化 macOS 沙箱拒绝规则，并修复目录删除、全屏、模型菜单、子进程及多项会话问题。
body.en: Adds a default-model variable and cross-session idle notices, strengthens macOS sandbox deny rules, and fixes deleted directories, fullscreen fallback, model menus, subprocesses, and session behavior.
body.ja: 既定モデル変数とセッション間のアイドル通知を追加し、macOS サンドボックスの拒否規則を強化。削除済みディレクトリ、全画面表示、モデル一覧、子プロセス、セッションの問題を修正しました。
body.ko: 기본 모델 변수와 세션 간 유휴 알림을 추가하고 macOS 샌드박스 거부 규칙을 강화했으며 삭제된 디렉터리, 전체 화면, 모델 메뉴, 하위 프로세스 및 세션 문제를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable: sets the model new sessions start on, while a `/model` pick still overrides it and persists across restarts (unlike `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`)
Added `notify_when_idle` to cross-session `SendMessage`: ask another Claude Code session on this machine to send one notice when it next goes idle — opt-in, one-shot, no polling (macOS and Linux)
Sandbox: on macOS, wildcard read-deny rules (e.g. `**/.env`) now take precedence inside allowed read regions, cover matched directories' contents, and can't be bypassed by renaming the denied file
Fixed clipboard copy, background housekeeping, background sessions, and local MCP logs breaking after the directory a session had switched into was removed (since 2.1.229)
Fixed the fullscreen renderer failing permanently after a single failed start: it now falls back to the classic renderer instead of exiting on every subsequent launch
Fixed the `/model` picker rendering taller than the terminal: it now shows only as many models as fit the window, with the rest reachable by scrolling
Fixed `SendMessage` calls being rejected when a malformed closing tag left the message text inside the summary field
Fixed unhandled promise rejections when a subprocess fails to start, for example `powershell.exe` on WSL with Windows interop disabled (regression in 2.1.234)
Fixed fullscreen mode sometimes not showing a newly sent message until the next update after the terminal was resized
Fixed a blank band that could remain above the prompt after clearing a multi-line prompt, and panes not repainting after resizing the terminal away and back, in fullscreen mode
Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt sometimes not appearing at startup while still capturing the first keypress as approval
Fixed terminal tab titles jumping in tmux (iTerm tmux integration): the title is now written only when its text changes instead of animating every 960ms
Fixed an unclear error when the cloud environments list came back empty or malformed
Fixed the Fable 5 first-time usage-credits prompt auto-selecting the fallback model after 60 seconds with no answer when using Remote Control
Fixed spinner tips never appearing, with a repeated background error, when the cached guest-pass reward in `~/.claude.json` was malformed
Fixed skills hot-reload in SDK/VS Code sessions raising an error on every skills change after the session's working directory was deleted (2.1.229+)
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions released on idle, retire, or startup timeout occasionally resuming on another runner before the post-session hook had finished
Fixed the Clawd mascot's eyes and feet rendering unevenly in iTerm2 at some font sizes
Fixed occasional runaway session recaps: recap text (automatic and `/recap`) is now capped at 400 characters, cut at a word boundary
Improved startup performance: the session counter is now written in the background
Improved auto mode: `Monitor` allow rules are now set aside while auto mode is active, so Monitor commands are reviewed the same way Bash commands are
Improved auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled: the classifier now uses the same defaults as on the Claude API, including severity-scored classification
Improved auto mode: the git status check can no longer be fooled by a repo's `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` setting into reporting a clean tree
Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list
`/goal`: an idle session whose goal is parked behind long-running background work now checks in automatically after 30 minutes (then 1h, 2h) instead of waiting for you to return
`/usage` now shows the usage-credits spend row for Team and Enterprise members, and shows a capped row at 0% before anything is spent
SIGTERM in print/SDK mode no longer records an interrupted turn or synthetic tool denials before exiting; running commands are still terminated and the process still exits with code 143
Pressing Enter on a slash-command typo or a command unavailable in this session now reports it instead of running the closest fuzzy match; prefixes and aliases still run
Remote Control now marks a session offline within seconds when the CLI exits or its terminal closes
`SendMessage` now refuses further messages to a session up front once a rapid burst would exceed what that session's inbox accepts, instead of reporting them sent while they were dropped
Aligned the session title chip on the prompt border with the footer's right edge
Right-aligned footer items (goal indicator, session state, background agent status) and truncated notices now share a consistent right margin with the rest of the prompt area
[VSCode] Added screen reader support for the transcript: live announcements for replies, permission requests, errors, and status changes, plus per-turn heading navigation

title.zh-TW: Agents 儀表板、工作目錄與診斷工具
title.zh-CN: Agents 仪表板、工作目录与诊断工具
title.en: Agents dashboard, working directory, and diagnostics
title.ja: Agents ダッシュボード、作業ディレクトリ、診断
title.ko: Agents 대시보드, 작업 디렉터리 및 진단

body.zh-TW: 新增互動式 Agents 儀表板、/cd 等目錄命令、codex queue、更多 Vim 編輯與強化版 doctor；並改善訊息喚醒、權限還原與 SDK 設定。
body.zh-CN: 新增交互式 Agents 仪表板、/cd 等目录命令、codex queue、更多 Vim 编辑与增强版 doctor；并改进消息唤醒、权限恢复与 SDK 设置。
body.en: Adds an interactive Agents dashboard, directory commands, codex queue, more Vim editing, and expanded doctor diagnostics, plus better message wakeups, permission restoration, and SDK controls.
body.ja: 対話型 Agents ダッシュボード、ディレクトリ操作、codex queue、Vim 編集、doctor 診断を追加し、メッセージの復帰、権限復元、SDK 設定を改善しました。
body.ko: 대화형 Agents 대시보드, 디렉터리 명령, codex queue, Vim 편집, 확장된 doctor 진단을 추가하고 메시지 깨우기, 권한 복원 및 SDK 제어를 개선했습니다.

items.original:
Added an interactive `codex agents` dashboard for searching, starting, opening, renaming, and stopping tasks, with configurable shortcuts. (#39094, #39112, #39114, #39142)
Added `/cd`, `/pwd`, and `/cwd` commands for managing the working directory in TUI sessions. (#38894)
Added `codex queue` for sending messages to existing local or remote sessions. (#39092)
Expanded Vim editing with character replacement and more change motions such as `cw`, `c$`, and `cc`. (#39661)
`codex doctor` now diagnoses endpoint protection, network/proxy failures, desktop app state, and update connectivity. (#38827, #38918, #39060, #39074)
SDK users can now pass exact CLI config overrides and select `max` or `ultra` reasoning effort. (#38817, #39662)
Queued messages now wake idle sessions reliably, resolve duplicate session names more usefully, and preserve pasted or deferred command semantics. (#39034, #39385, #39604)
Resumed and forked threads now restore their active permission profile instead of silently falling back to current defaults. (#39153)
Fixed duplicate sub-agent activity and tightened TUI routing for sub-agent notifications and approvals. (#39049, #39088)
Realtime WebRTC sideband connections now reconnect after unexpected transport loss without dropping pending output. (#39257)
Inline TUI history now remains available in Windows Terminal scrollback. (#39619)
Inactive TUI thread replay buffers are now bounded to prevent excessive retained streamed output. (#39081)
Clarified that external contributions should go through issues and design discussion rather than pull requests. (#39089)
Documented DNS exfiltration risks and trust limitations for secure devcontainers. (#39283)

title.zh-TW: 對話管理、Hooks 與 Bedrock 支援
title.zh-CN: 会话管理、Hooks 与 Bedrock 支持
title.en: Conversation controls, hooks, and Bedrock
title.ja: 会話管理、Hook、Bedrock 対応
title.ko: 대화 관리, 훅 및 Bedrock 지원

body.zh-TW: 新增 Markdown 匯出、工作階段分支與封存、成本顯示、Amazon Bedrock Provider，以及非同步 Hook 與 MCP 呼叫；同時改善恢復工作階段與設定一致性。
body.zh-CN: 新增 Markdown 导出、会话分支与归档、成本显示、Amazon Bedrock Provider，以及异步 Hook 与 MCP 调用；同时改进恢复会话与设置一致性。
body.en: Adds Markdown export, session fork/archive controls, cost visibility, Amazon Bedrock, and asynchronous hooks with MCP calls, while improving resumed-session and settings consistency.
body.ja: Markdown 出力、セッションの分岐・アーカイブ、コスト表示、Amazon Bedrock、非同期 Hook と MCP 呼び出しを追加し、再開セッションと設定の一貫性を改善しました。
body.ko: Markdown 내보내기, 세션 포크/보관, 비용 표시, Amazon Bedrock, 비동기 훅 및 MCP 호출을 추가하고 재개 세션과 설정 일관성을 개선했습니다.

items.original:
Export complete TUI conversations to Markdown with `/export`, either to the clipboard or a new file. (#37358)
Fork sessions with `codex exec fork`, and archive or restore sessions from the TUI resume picker. (#37367, #37369, #37371)
Draft prompts while the TUI initializes, with resume and fork progress shown during startup. (#38642, #38788)
View estimated thread credits or cost in `/status`, status lines, and terminal titles for eligible workspaces. (#38281, #38282)
Use Amazon Bedrock Runtime as a built-in provider with AWS profile, region, and GPT-5.6 routing support. (#38470)
Hooks can now run commands asynchronously and invoke MCP tools. (#37533, #38705)
Model switches and settings updates no longer leave stale instructions behind or change an active turn midstream. (#37260, #38785)
Resumed sessions now restore their persisted working directory and approval policy, with more accurate transcript previews. (#37198, #37368, #38605)
Turns reconnect through temporary provider outages, and MCP servers recover after OAuth reauthentication without restarting Codex. (#37337, #37485, #38418)
TUI startup no longer lets buffered terminal input activate prompts accidentally, and onboarding appears when authentication is missing. (#38641, #38643, #38644)
Composer and transcript rendering now handle CRLF pastes, wrapped whitespace, and long URLs correctly. (#37709, #38380, #38704)
Sandbox restrictions now fail closed for denied or unreadable paths across Linux and Windows. (#37875, #38026, #38416, #38660)
The bundled skill-creator guide is more focused, and validation now rejects unfinished TODO placeholders. (#38384)

title.zh-TW: 外掛帶著走，失手時先斷網
title.zh-CN: 插件随身带，失手时先断网
title.en: Portable plugins with a safer fallback
title.ja: 持ち運べるプラグインと、失敗時の遮断
title.ko: 들고 다니는 플러그인과 실패 시 차단

body.zh-TW: 你換電腦或加入新工作區時，現在能安裝可攜式 Agent Plugins（代理外掛，替 Codex 加上工作能力的小工具），也能在本機、個人、工作區和遠端目錄找它們。像一只可攜式工具箱：工具可在不同工具櫃找到；若封條檢查失敗，箱子就先不接外部管線。安全邊界也加厚了：外掛會被更嚴格隔離；如果更新安全政策失敗，Codex 會拒絕網路連線。
body.zh-CN: 换电脑或加入新工作区时，现在能安装可携带的 Agent Plugins（代理插件，给 Codex 加上工作能力的小工具），也能在本机、个人、工作区和远程目录里找它们。像一只可携带的工具箱：工具可在不同工具柜找到；若封条检查失败，箱子就先不接外部管线。安全边界也加厚了：插件会被更严格地隔离；如果更新安全策略失败，Codex 会拒绝联网。
body.en: Moving to another computer or workspace no longer means hunting down your add-ons again. You can install portable Agent Plugins and search local, personal, workspace, and remote catalogs for them. Think of a portable toolbox: its tools can be found in different tool cabinets; if the seal check fails, the box does not connect to external lines yet. The release also tightens plugin isolation and denies network access if a policy update fails.
body.ja: 別のパソコンやワークスペースへ移っても、追加機能を探し直さなくてよくなる。持ち運び可能な Agent Plugins を導入でき、ローカル、個人用、ワークスペース、リモートのカタログから探せる。持ち運べる工具箱のようなものだ。道具は別々の工具棚から見つけられ、封印の確認に失敗すれば箱は外部の回線へつながない。プラグインの隔離も強まり、ポリシー更新に失敗したときはネットワーク接続を拒む。
body.ko: 다른 컴퓨터나 작업 공간으로 옮겨도 추가 기능을 다시 찾느라 헤맬 일이 줄어든다. 휴대 가능한 Agent Plugins를 설치하고 로컬, 개인, 작업 공간, 원격 카탈로그에서 찾을 수 있다. 휴대용 공구 상자와 같다. 도구는 서로 다른 공구함에서 찾을 수 있고, 봉인 검사가 실패하면 상자는 외부 회선에 연결하지 않는다. 플러그인 격리도 더 엄격해졌고, 정책 갱신에 실패하면 네트워크 접속을 거부한다.

items.original:
Install portable Agent Plugins and search across local, personal, workspace, and remote plugin catalogs. (#36544, #36409, #36919, #36796)
Harden plugin isolation and deny network access when policy updates fail. (#37027, #36967, #36037)

title.zh-TW: 把長對話分冊收藏，匯入內容不重複
title.zh-CN: 把长对话分册收藏，导入内容不重复
title.en: Shelving long chats without duplicate imports
title.ja: 長い会話を棚に分け、重複なく取り込む
title.ko: 긴 대화를 칸에 나누고 중복 없이 가져오기

body.zh-TW: 一串對話越聊越長，找上週那段決定常像翻亂掉的筆記本。現在可把 conversations（對話）放進會保留的區段，自己調整順序；很長的逐字稿則分段載入，不必一次塞滿畫面。另一頭，Cursor 管理的 skills（技能，教 AI 做特定工作的說明）可以匯入，已匯入的 Claude 和 Cursor 對話也會同步變更而不複製出兩份。像替筆記貼標籤、逐頁翻閱，再把兩本筆記對齊同一頁。
body.zh-CN: 一串对话越聊越长，找上周那段决定常像翻乱掉的笔记本。现在可把 conversations（对话）放进会保留的区段，自己调整顺序；很长的逐字稿则分段加载，不必一次塞满画面。另一头，Cursor 管理的 skills（技能，教 AI 做特定工作的说明）可以导入，已导入的 Claude 和 Cursor 对话也会同步变更而不复制出两份。像给笔记贴标签、逐页翻阅，再把两本笔记对齐同一页。
body.en: When a chat runs for weeks, finding one decision can feel like opening a notebook at random. Conversations can now live in persistent sections that you order yourself, while long transcripts load a piece at a time. You can also import Cursor-managed skills, and imported Claude and Cursor conversations stay synchronized without spawning duplicates. It is like labeling notebooks, turning pages as needed, and keeping two copies aligned.
body.ja: 何週間も続く会話から決定事項を探すのは、ばらばらのノートをめくるようなものだった。会話を永続的な区分へ入れ、順番も手動で並べ替えられる。長い記録は少しずつ読める。Cursor が管理する skills も取り込め、取り込んだ Claude と Cursor の会話は複製を作らず変更を同期する。ノートに見出しを付け、必要な頁だけ開き、二冊を同じ頁にそろえる感覚である。
body.ko: 몇 주째 이어진 대화에서 결정 하나를 찾는 일은 뒤섞인 공책을 넘기는 것과 같았다. 이제 대화를 계속 남는 구역에 넣고 순서를 직접 정할 수 있으며, 긴 기록은 조금씩 읽는다. Cursor가 관리하는 skills도 가져올 수 있고, 가져온 Claude와 Cursor 대화의 변경은 사본을 만들지 않고 동기화된다. 공책에 꼬리표를 붙이고 필요한 쪽만 펼친 뒤 두 권을 같은 쪽에 맞추는 느낌이다.

Organize conversations into persistent, manually ordered sections and browse long transcripts incrementally. (#35722, #36007, #36380, #36948, #36950)

title.zh-TW: 把核准交給審核，陌生專案先問清楚
title.zh-CN: 把批准交给审核，陌生项目先问清楚
title.en: Reviewed approvals and a pause for unfamiliar projects
title.ja: 審査済み承認と、見知らぬプロジェクトでの停止
title.ko: 검토된 승인과 낯선 프로젝트 앞의 멈춤

body.zh-TW: 你在命令列跑重複任務時，可用新的 `--approve-for-me` CLI flag（命令列旗標，附在指令後的開關）開啟自動審核過的核准，不必每一步都手動按許可。但新本機專案不是直接放行：Codex 會要求你明確信任，並在使用 credentials（登入憑證，證明身分的資料）前套用受管理的登入限制。像把常用包裹交給通過規則的收件櫃；沒有寄件人資訊的新包裹，仍要你親自簽收。
body.zh-CN: 你在命令行跑重复任务时，可用新的 `--approve-for-me` CLI flag（命令行标志，附在命令后的开关）开启自动审核过的批准，不必每一步都手动按允许。但新本地项目不是直接放行：Codex 会要求你明确建立信任，并在使用 credentials（登录凭证，证明身份的资料）前执行受管理的登录限制。像把常用包裹交给通过规则的收件柜；没有寄件人信息的新包裹，仍要你亲自签收。
body.en: For repeated command-line work, the new `--approve-for-me` flag enables automatically reviewed approvals, so every routine step need not stop for a click. An unfamiliar local project does not get that treatment: Codex asks for explicit trust and applies managed authentication restrictions before using credentials. It is like a parcel locker that accepts packages matching its rules, while an unmarked box still waits for your signature.
body.ja: 繰り返すコマンド作業では、新しい `--approve-for-me` フラグで、自動的に審査された承認を使える。毎回クリックで止まらなくてよい。ただし見知らぬローカルプロジェクトは別である。Codex は明示的な信頼を求め、認証情報を使う前に管理された認証制限を適用する。条件の合う荷物だけ受け取る宅配ロッカーと、宛先不明の箱には署名を求める受付の組み合わせである。
body.ko: 반복하는 명령줄 작업에서는 새 `--approve-for-me` 플래그로 자동 검토된 승인을 쓸 수 있어 매 단계에서 클릭으로 멈추지 않는다. 다만 낯선 로컬 프로젝트는 바로 통과하지 못한다. Codex는 명시적인 신뢰를 요구하고 자격 증명을 쓰기 전에 관리되는 인증 제한을 적용한다. 조건에 맞는 소포만 받는 무인 보관함과, 출처가 불분명한 상자에는 서명을 요구하는 접수대의 조합이다.

items.original:
Enable automatically reviewed approvals with the new `--approve-for-me` CLI flag. (#36373)
Require explicit trust for unfamiliar local projects and enforce managed authentication restrictions before credentials are used. (#36960, #37132)

title.zh-TW: MCP 換了新規格，找工具不再堵車
title.zh-CN: MCP 换了新规格，找工具不再堵车
title.en: A newer MCP route for tool discovery
title.ja: 新しい MCP 規格で、道具探しの渋滞を減らす
title.ko: 새 MCP 규격으로 도구 찾기의 정체 줄이기

body.zh-TW: 你叫 Codex 接上外部服務時，MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）現在可選用 2026-07-28 版規格。它支援分頁探索：工具清單很長時分批拿，不必整包搬進來；也能多輪請求，並讓伺服器在背景慢慢啟動而不堵住其他工作。這像餐廳不再把整本菜單塞到你手上，先翻一頁、再點下一輪；廚房備料時，桌邊對話照樣繼續。
body.zh-CN: 你叫 Codex 接上外部服务时，MCP（Model Context Protocol，让 AI 连接外部工具的协议）现在可选用 2026-07-28 版规格。它支持分页发现：工具清单很长时分批拿，不必整包搬进来；也能多轮请求，并让服务器在后台慢慢启动而不堵住其他工作。这像餐厅不再把整本菜单塞到你手上，先翻一页、再点下一轮；厨房备料时，桌边对话照样继续。
body.en: When Codex connects to an outside service, it can now opt into the 2026-07-28 MCP protocol. Long tool lists can be discovered page by page, requests can take multiple rounds, and a server can start in the background instead of blocking the rest of the work. It is like reading a menu one page at a time and ordering another course while the kitchen is still warming up.
body.ja: Codex を外部サービスにつなぐとき、2026-07-28 版の MCP プロトコルを選べる。長い道具一覧は頁ごとに見つけられ、要求は複数回に分けられ、サーバーは他の作業を止めずに裏で起動できる。分厚いメニューを一度に抱えず一頁ずつ読み、厨房の準備中にも次の注文を出せるようなものである。
body.ko: Codex를 외부 서비스에 연결할 때 2026-07-28판 MCP 프로토콜을 선택할 수 있다. 긴 도구 목록은 쪽마다 찾아보고, 요청은 여러 차례에 걸쳐 보낼 수 있으며, 서버는 다른 일을 막지 않고 뒤에서 시작한다. 두꺼운 메뉴를 한꺼번에 받지 않고 한 쪽씩 보며 주방이 준비하는 동안 다음 주문을 넣는 것과 같다.

items.original: Support the opt-in MCP 2026-07-28 protocol, including paginated discovery, multi-round requests, and non-blocking server startup. (#35724, #35725, #35590, #35742)

title.zh-TW: Bedrock 查過的網頁先暫存，對話也能遠端壓縮
title.zh-CN: Bedrock 查过的网页先暂存，对话也能远程压缩
title.en: Cached searches and remote conversation compression for Bedrock
title.ja: Bedrock で検索結果を保持し、会話を遠隔圧縮
title.ko: Bedrock의 검색 결과 보관과 원격 대화 압축

body.zh-TW: 用 Amazon Bedrock 跑 Codex 時，重看剛查過的網頁不必每次從頭取資料。網路搜尋可使用快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用），對話也支援遠端壓縮：把過長的對話收成較短的上下文，交給遠端處理。像旅行筆記本：查過的地圖頁先收在夾層，需要時直接翻回；內容太多時把舊頁整理成摘要，旅程仍接得上。原本的問題和最近脈絡仍會留在眼前。
body.zh-CN: 用 Amazon Bedrock 跑 Codex 时，重看刚查过的网页不必每次从头取资料。网络搜索可使用缓存（把查过的结果暂存起来直接用），对话也支持远程压缩：把过长的对话收成较短的上下文，交给远程处理。像旅行笔记本：查过的地图页先收在夹层，需要时直接翻回；内容太多时把旧页整理成摘要，旅程仍接得上。
body.en: When Codex runs through Amazon Bedrock, web searches can use a cache, keeping results already fetched handy, and long conversations can be compacted remotely into shorter context. Think of a travel notebook: put map pages you have checked into a pocket and turn back to them when needed; when there is too much content, condense old pages into a summary and the trip still holds together.
body.ja: Amazon Bedrock 経由で Codex を使うと、ウェブ検索の結果をキャッシュして再利用でき、長い会話は遠隔で短い文脈へ圧縮できる。旅行ノートのようなものだ。見た地図のページはポケットにしまい、必要なときすぐ開き直せる。内容が多すぎれば古いページを要約に整理しても、旅は途切れない。
body.ko: Amazon Bedrock으로 Codex를 쓸 때 웹 검색 결과를 캐시에 보관해 다시 쓸 수 있고, 긴 대화는 원격에서 짧은 문맥으로 압축할 수 있다. 여행 노트와 같다. 확인한 지도 페이지는 주머니에 넣어 필요할 때 바로 다시 펼치고, 내용이 너무 많으면 오래된 페이지를 요약으로 정리해도 여행은 이어진다.

items.original: Enable cached web search and remote conversation compaction for Amazon Bedrock. (#36938, #36981)

title.zh-TW: 螢幕上的密碼和令牌，先遮住再重播
title.zh-CN: 屏幕上的密码和令牌，先遮住再重播
title.en: Masking secrets before commands are replayed
title.ja: 再生前に秘密とトークンを隠す
title.ko: 명령을 다시 보여 주기 전 비밀과 토큰 가리기

body.zh-TW: 你把命令貼到螢幕分享或回頭翻對話時，最怕登入資料跟著露出來。Codex 現在會從顯示的命令和重播的對話歷史遮蔽 secrets（機密資料，例如密碼）與完整的 bearer tokens（持有人令牌，拿到就能通行的授權令牌）。像銀行對帳單把帳號中段塗黑：你仍看得出是哪筆操作，旁人卻不能拿那串字直接冒用。它遮的是畫面與重播內容，不是替你撤銷已經外流的憑證。
body.zh-CN: 你把命令贴到屏幕分享或回头翻对话时，最怕登录资料跟着露出来。Codex 现在会从显示的命令和重播的对话历史遮蔽 secrets（机密资料，例如密码）与完整的 bearer tokens（持有人令牌，拿到就能通行的授权令牌）。像银行对账单把账号中段涂黑：你仍看得出是哪笔操作，旁人却不能拿那串字直接冒用。它遮的是画面与重播内容，不是替你撤销已经外泄的凭证。
body.en: A command pasted into a screen share should not also paste your keys. Codex now redacts secrets and complete bearer tokens from displayed commands and replayed conversation history. It is like blacking out the middle of an account number on a statement: you can still recognize the transaction, but someone else cannot reuse the number. This protects the display and replay, not a credential that has already leaked elsewhere.
body.ja: 画面共有や会話の再生で、ログイン情報まで見えてしまうのは困る。Codex は表示するコマンドと再生する会話履歴から secrets と完全な bearer token を伏せるようになった。明細の口座番号の中央を塗りつぶすようなもので、操作は見分けられても、その文字列を他人が使うことはできない。守るのは表示と再生であり、すでに漏れた認証情報を取り消す機能ではない。
body.ko: 화면 공유나 대화 다시 보기에서 로그인 정보까지 보이면 곤란하다. Codex는 표시하는 명령과 다시 재생하는 대화 기록에서 secrets와 완전한 bearer token을 가린다. 거래 내역의 계좌 번호 가운데를 검게 칠하는 것과 같아서, 어떤 작업인지는 알아봐도 다른 사람이 그 문자열을 재사용할 수 없다. 이미 다른 곳으로 새어 나간 자격 증명을 취소하는 기능은 아니다.

items.original: Redact secrets and complete bearer tokens from displayed commands and replayed conversation history. (#36893, #36908)

title.zh-TW: 游標回來後，終端機不再吞掉你剛打的字
title.zh-CN: 光标回来后，终端不再吞掉你刚打的字
title.en: Keeping terminal keystrokes from getting lost
title.ja: 戻った直後のキー入力を端末が取りこぼさない
title.ko: 다시 초점을 받을 때 터미널 입력을 놓치지 않기

body.zh-TW: 切回終端機正要補一個指令，字卻消失或卡著不動，往往不是你手快按錯。這版修正三種會弄丟或堵住輸入的時刻：視窗重新取得焦點、MCP 伺服器初始化，以及 Ghostty 處理鍵盤快捷鍵時。像接線員剛回到座位、後台正開機、同事按下內線鍵的同時，電話還是會接進來，不會把你剛說的第一句丟掉。中斷工作再回來，也不必先猜剛才那行有沒有送出。
body.zh-CN: 切回终端正要补一条命令，字却消失或卡着不动，往往不是你手快按错。这版修正三种会弄丢或堵住输入的时刻：窗口重新取得焦点、MCP 服务器初始化，以及 Ghostty 处理键盘快捷键时。像接线员刚回到座位、后台正开机、同事按下内线键的同时，电话还是会接进来，不会把你刚说的第一句丢掉。
body.en: You switch back to the terminal to finish a command, type a few letters, and they vanish or stall. This release fixes three moments that could lose or block input: focus returning to the window, MCP servers initializing, and Ghostty handling keyboard shortcuts. It is like a phone line that still catches your first sentence while the operator sits down, the back office boots up, or someone presses an extension key.
body.ja: 端末へ戻ってコマンドを補おうとしたのに、打った文字が消えたり止まったりすることがあった。この版は、ウィンドウにフォーカスが戻る時、MCP サーバーの初期化時、Ghostty がキーボードショートカットを処理する時の入力取りこぼしや停止を直す。交換手が席に戻る時や裏方が起動中でも、電話の最初の一言を落とさないようなものだ。
body.ko: 터미널로 돌아와 명령을 마저 쓰려는데 방금 친 글자가 사라지거나 멈추는 일이 있었다. 이 판은 창이 다시 초점을 받을 때, MCP 서버가 초기화될 때, Ghostty가 키보드 바로 가기를 처리할 때 입력이 사라지거나 막히는 문제를 고친다. 교환원이 자리에 막 돌아왔거나 뒷방이 켜지는 중이어도 전화 첫마디를 놓치지 않는 것과 같다.

items.original: Prevent lost or stalled terminal input when focus returns, MCP servers initialize, or Ghostty handles keyboard shortcuts. (#35649, #35957, #36834)

title.zh-TW: 日文、表情和連結，游標終於站對位置
title.zh-CN: 日文、表情和链接，光标终于站对位置
title.en: A cursor that lands correctly around Japanese and emoji
title.ja: 日本語や絵文字のそばでも、カーソルが正しい場所に立つ
title.ko: 일본어와 이모지 곁에서도 커서가 제자리를 찾기

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機看日文、emoji 或超連結時，游標有時像踩錯格子，文字也可能在畫面邊緣歪掉。這版修正日文字元、emoji、hyperlinks（超連結，點了會跳到其他位置的文字）以及靠近 viewport boundaries（可視畫面邊界）的文字顯示和游標位置。它像方格紙的尺終於認得寬字和窄字：走到紙張邊緣前會量好，不把下一格畫到紙外。
body.zh-CN: 你在终端看日文、emoji 或超链接时，光标有时像踩错格子，文字也可能在画面边缘歪掉。这版修正日文字符、emoji、hyperlinks（超链接，点了会跳到其他位置的文字）以及靠近 viewport boundaries（可视画面边界）的文字显示和光标位置。它像方格纸的尺终于认得宽字和窄字：走到纸张边缘前会量好，不把下一格画到纸外。
body.en: Japanese text, emoji, and hyperlinks can take up screen space in ways a terminal must count carefully. This release corrects their rendering and cursor positions, including text near the edge of the visible viewport. It is like a ruler on graph paper finally recognizing wide and narrow characters, measuring before it reaches the paper's edge instead of drawing the next square off the page.
body.ja: 端末で日本語、絵文字、ハイパーリンクを見ると、カーソルが一つずれたり、画面端で文字が乱れたりすることがあった。この版はそれらの表示とカーソル位置、さらに表示領域の端に近い文字を正しく扱う。方眼紙の定規が幅の広い字と狭い字を見分け、紙の端の前で長さを測るような修正である。
body.ko: 터미널에서 일본어, 이모지, 하이퍼링크를 보면 커서가 한 칸 어긋나거나 화면 가장자리에서 글자가 흐트러질 때가 있었다. 이 판은 이들의 표시와 커서 위치, 그리고 보이는 화면 끝 가까이의 글자를 바로잡는다. 모눈종이의 자가 넓은 글자와 좁은 글자를 구분하고 종이 끝 전에 길이를 재는 것과 같은 수정이다.

items.original: Correct rendering and cursor positioning for Japanese characters, emoji, hyperlinks, and text near viewport boundaries. (#35960, #35962, #37166)

title.zh-TW: Windows 背景程序叫得停，路徑也不再認錯門牌
title.zh-CN: Windows 后台进程叫得停，路径也不再认错门牌
title.en: Stopping Windows background work and reading its paths correctly
title.ja: Windows の裏方プロセスを止め、パスも正しく読む
title.ko: Windows 백그라운드 작업을 멈추고 경로도 바르게 읽기

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上叫停背景程序時，Codex 現在會正確中斷它，不必等它自己收工。Windows filesystem paths（檔案系統路徑，像檔案地址的寫法）也會一致處理，避免同一個資料夾因為路徑格式不同而找錯地方。這像工地的總開關終於接到每台機器，也把每條巷弄的門牌統一寫清楚：該停的能停，要找的門不會繞到隔壁去。
body.zh-CN: 在 Windows 上叫停后台进程时，Codex 现在会正确中断它，不必等它自己收工。Windows filesystem paths（文件系统路径，像文件地址的写法）也会一致处理，避免同一个文件夹因为路径格式不同而找错地方。这像工地的总开关终于接到每台机器，也把每条巷弄的门牌统一写清楚：该停的能停，要找的门不会绕到隔壁。
body.en: On Windows, asking Codex to stop a background process now properly interrupts it instead of waiting for it to finish on its own. Windows filesystem paths are also handled consistently, so one folder is not mistaken for another because its address is written differently. It is like wiring the emergency switch to every machine and standardizing every street number at the same time.
body.ja: Windows でバックグラウンドのプロセスを止める指示が、正しく中断として届くようになった。Windows のファイルシステムパスも一貫して扱うため、同じフォルダを表記の違いで取り違えにくい。非常停止のスイッチが全ての機械につながり、路地の番地もそろえて書き直すようなものである。
body.ko: Windows에서 백그라운드 프로세스를 멈추라고 하면 이제 스스로 끝날 때까지 기다리지 않고 제대로 중단한다. Windows 파일 시스템 경로도 일관되게 다뤄 같은 폴더를 다른 주소 표기 때문에 잘못 찾는 일을 줄인다. 비상 정지 스위치를 모든 기계에 연결하고 골목의 번지를 통일해 적는 것과 같다.

items.original: Properly interrupt Windows background processes and handle Windows filesystem paths consistently. (#35655, #35851, #37129)

title.zh-TW: 內建 OpenAI 文件助手，少繞一圈找官方答案
title.zh-CN: 内置 OpenAI 文档助手，少绕一圈找官方答案
title.en: A sharper built-in guide to OpenAI docs
title.ja: OpenAI 文書を狙って探せる内蔵ガイド
title.ko: OpenAI 문서를 겨냥해 찾는 내장 안내

body.zh-TW: 你想確認 Codex 怎麼用、該選哪個模型，或 API workflow（API 工作流程，程式如何呼叫服務的一連串步驟）要怎麼接，現在內建的 OpenAI documentation skill（文件技能，協助查找官方說明的工具）會更有針對性地查官方來源，並給更清楚的指引。它像圖書館員先聽懂你要找的是使用說明、型號比較還是接線圖，再帶你到正確書架，而不是把整棟館藏推來。
body.zh-CN: 你想确认 Codex 怎么用、该选哪个模型，或 API workflow（API 工作流程，程序如何调用服务的一连串步骤）要怎么接，现在内置的 OpenAI documentation skill（文档技能，协助查找官方说明的工具）会更有针对性地查官方来源，并给更清楚的指引。它像图书管理员先听懂你要找的是使用说明、型号比较还是接线图，再带你到正确书架，而不是把整栋馆藏推来。
body.en: When you need to check how Codex works, choose a model, or connect an API workflow, the bundled OpenAI documentation skill now performs more targeted official-source lookup and gives clearer guidance. It is like a librarian first hearing whether you need a manual, a model comparison, or a wiring diagram, then walking you to that shelf instead of wheeling over the whole building.
body.ja: Codex の使い方、モデル選び、API ワークフローのつなぎ方を確かめたい時、同梱の OpenAI 文書 skill が公式情報をより狙って探し、分かりやすく案内する。司書が説明書、機種比較、配線図のどれを求めているか先に聞き、正しい棚へ連れていくようなものである。
body.ko: Codex 사용법, 모델 선택, API 작업 흐름 연결을 확인하고 싶을 때 내장 OpenAI 문서 skill이 공식 자료를 더 겨냥해 찾고 안내를 더 분명하게 한다. 사서가 설명서, 모델 비교, 배선도 중 무엇이 필요한지 먼저 듣고 맞는 서가로 데려가는 것과 같다.

items.original: Improve the bundled OpenAI documentation skill with targeted official-source lookup and clearer guidance for Codex, model selection, and API workflows. (#36014)

title.zh-TW: 底層零件升級，簽章鑰匙不再帶出保險庫
title.zh-CN: 底层零件升级，签名钥匙不再带出保险库
title.en: Updated internals and signing keys kept in the vault
title.ja: 内部部品を更新し、署名鍵は金庫から持ち出さない
title.ko: 내부 부품을 올리고 서명 키는 금고에 둔다

body.zh-TW: 這版也換了幾個底層零件：MCP SDK 升至 3.0.0、Ratatui 升至 0.30.2、V8 升至 150.4.0。macOS 發行版的 notarization（公證，讓系統確認軟體來源可信的簽章程序）則改用 Azure Key Vault 保護，不再匯出私密簽章金鑰。Linux 也不再發佈重複的 bundle archives（套裝壓縮檔），改用標準 `codex-package-<target>` 檔案。像工廠更新生產線：設備換新，簽章用的印章留在廠內保管櫃，出貨也統一走一種箱規。
body.zh-CN: 这版也换了几个底层零件：MCP SDK 升至 3.0.0、Ratatui 升至 0.30.2、V8 升至 150.4.0。macOS 发行版的 notarization（公证，让系统确认软件来源可信的签名程序）则改用 Azure Key Vault 保护，不再导出私密签名密钥。Linux 也不再发布重复的 bundle archives（套装压缩包），改用标准 `codex-package-<target>` 文件。像工厂更新生产线：设备换新，签名用的印章留在厂内保管柜，出货也统一走一种箱规。
body.en: Several internal parts move forward in this release: MCP SDK 3.0.0, Ratatui 0.30.2, and V8 150.4.0. macOS release notarization now uses Azure Key Vault rather than exporting private signing keys. Linux also stops publishing redundant bundle archives and uses the standard `codex-package-<target>` archives. Think of updating a factory production line: the equipment is replaced, the signing seal stays in a storage cabinet at the factory, and every shipment uses one box standard.
body.ja: この版では内部部品も更新された。MCP SDK は 3.0.0、Ratatui は 0.30.2、V8 は 150.4.0 である。macOS のリリース公証は秘密署名鍵を外へ出さず、Azure Key Vault を使う。Linux は重複したバンドルアーカイブの公開をやめ、標準の `codex-package-<target>` を使う。工場の生産ラインを更新するようなものだ。設備を入れ替え、署名用の印章は工場内の保管棚に置き、出荷も一種類の箱の規格に統一する。
body.ko: 이 판은 내부 부품도 올렸다. MCP SDK는 3.0.0, Ratatui는 0.30.2, V8은 150.4.0이 되었다. macOS 배포 공증은 개인 서명 키를 밖으로 내보내지 않고 Azure Key Vault를 쓴다. Linux는 겹치는 묶음 압축 파일을 더 내놓지 않고 표준 `codex-package-<target>` 압축 파일을 쓴다. 공장 생산 라인을 업데이트하는 것과 같다. 설비를 새로 바꾸고, 서명용 도장은 공장 안 보관함에 두며, 출고도 한 종류의 상자 규격으로 통일한다.

items.original:
Upgrade the MCP SDK to 3.0.0, Ratatui to 0.30.2, and V8 to 150.4.0. (#36001, #35959, #35831)
Secure macOS release notarization using Azure Key Vault instead of exporting private signing keys. (#37154)
Stop publishing redundant Linux bundle archives; use the standard `codex-package-<target>` release archives. (#36342)

title.zh-TW: 舊的全自動旗標退場，改用工作區沙盒
title.zh-CN: 旧的全自动标志退场，改用工作区沙盒
title.en: The old full-auto flag exits; workspace sandboxing replaces it
title.ja: 旧 full-auto フラグをやめ、ワークスペースのサンドボックスへ
title.ko: 옛 full-auto 플래그를 빼고 작업 공간 샌드박스로

body.zh-TW: 若你的腳本還寫著 `codex exec --full-auto`，這版起它已被移除。改用 `--sandbox workspace-write`：sandbox（沙盒，限制程式可碰範圍的隔離區）把可寫入範圍限在工作區。像舊鑰匙已停用，改領一把只能開辦公室的卡；你仍能在專案內工作，但卡片清楚標示能到哪裡。更新自動化指令時，直接把舊旗標換成新參數。
body.zh-CN: 若你的脚本还写着 `codex exec --full-auto`，这版起它已被移除。改用 `--sandbox workspace-write`：sandbox（沙盒，限制程序可碰范围的隔离区）把可写入范围限在工作区。像旧钥匙已停用，改领一把只能开办公室的卡；你仍能在项目内工作，但卡片清楚标示能到哪里。更新自动化命令时，直接把旧标志换成新参数。
body.en: If a script still says `codex exec --full-auto`, that flag has been removed. Use `--sandbox workspace-write` instead. A sandbox limits where a program may act; this setting limits writes to the workspace. It is like retiring an old master key and issuing a card that opens the office only. When updating automation, replace the old flag with the new argument.
body.ja: スクリプトに `codex exec --full-auto` が残っているなら、この版から使えない。代わりに `--sandbox workspace-write` を使う。sandbox はプログラムが触れられる範囲を隔てる仕組みで、この指定では書き込み先をワークスペースに限る。古い万能鍵を止め、事務所だけ開くカードへ替えるようなものである。自動化を更新する時は古いフラグをこの引数へ置き換える。
body.ko: 스크립트에 `codex exec --full-auto`가 남아 있다면 이 판부터는 쓸 수 없다. 대신 `--sandbox workspace-write`를 쓴다. sandbox는 프로그램이 손댈 수 있는 범위를 가두는 장치이며, 이 지정은 쓰기 위치를 작업 공간으로 제한한다. 낡은 만능 열쇠를 없애고 사무실만 여는 카드를 받는 것과 같다. 자동화 명령을 고칠 때 옛 플래그를 새 인수로 바꾸면 된다.

items.original: Remove the deprecated `codex exec --full-auto` flag; use `--sandbox workspace-write` instead. (#36054)

title.zh-TW: 代理執行與附件修復
title.zh-CN: 代理执行与附件修复
title.en: Agent execution and attachment fixes
title.ja: エージェント実行と添付ファイルの修正
title.ko: 에이전트 실행 및 첨부 파일 수정

body.zh-TW: 統一代理執行路徑，並修正部分斜線命令消失、Vim 插入模式無法開啟背景任務，以及 Ogg 音訊與影片附件被拒絕的問題。
body.zh-CN: 统一代理执行路径，并修复部分斜线命令消失、Vim 插入模式无法打开后台任务，以及 Ogg 音频与视频附件被拒绝的问题。
body.en: Unifies the agent execution path and fixes missing slash commands, opening background tasks in Vim insert mode, and rejected Ogg audio/video attachments.
body.ja: エージェントの実行経路を統一し、スラッシュコマンドの消失、Vim 挿入モードでのバックグラウンドタスク操作、Ogg 添付の拒否を修正しました。
body.ko: 에이전트 실행 경로를 통합하고 슬래시 명령 누락, Vim 입력 모드의 백그라운드 작업 열기, Ogg 오디오/비디오 첨부 거부 문제를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
Improved the agent execution harness by consolidating onto a single execution path, giving more consistent tool, hook, and prompt behavior.
Fixed `/teamwork-preview` and some other slash commands disappearing for some users.
Fixed `Enter` not opening an active background task or subagent while the prompt was in Vim insert mode.
Fixed attaching Ogg audio and video files such as `.ogg`, `.opus` and `.ogv`, which the model rejected because they were sent as the generic `application/ogg`.

title.zh-TW: MCP 管理與終端體驗更新
title.zh-CN: MCP 管理与终端体验更新
title.en: MCP management and terminal improvements
title.ja: MCP 管理とターミナル操作の改善
title.ko: MCP 관리 및 터미널 경험 개선

body.zh-TW: 新增 MCP 管理子命令，改善大型工作區的檔案補全與推理強度設定，並修正終端跳脫字元、游標、忽略規則和背景任務等問題。
body.zh-CN: 新增 MCP 管理子命令，改进大型工作区的文件补全与推理强度设置，并修复终端转义字符、光标、忽略规则和后台任务等问题。
body.en: Adds MCP management commands, improves file completion and reasoning-effort controls, and fixes terminal escapes, cursor alignment, ignore rules, and background-task behavior.
body.ja: MCP 管理コマンドを追加し、ファイル補完と推論量設定を改善。端末のエスケープ表示、カーソル位置、無視ルール、バックグラウンドタスクなどを修正しました。
body.ko: MCP 관리 명령을 추가하고 파일 완성과 추론 강도 설정을 개선했으며 터미널 이스케이프, 커서 정렬, 무시 규칙 및 백그라운드 작업 문제를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
Added `mcp` subcommands (`add`, `remove`, `list`, `enable`, `disable`) for managing MCP servers in your user-level `mcp_config.json` without hand-editing it, covering both stdio and HTTP servers through `--type`, `--env` and `--header`.
Improved `@` file path completion in large workspaces by running the lookup through the bundled `ripgrep` and debouncing keystrokes, and by ranking a file whose name matches your query above a directory or generated artifact that merely contains it.
Improved `/effort` so it adjusts reasoning effort for Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.7 Flash when you sign in with a Gemini API key, a route that previously reported those models as not adjustable even though the same models were adjustable on every other sign-in path.
Fixed links printing as raw escape sequences on terminals that do not implement OSC 8 hyperlinks, such as Terminal.app, and extended the same detection to command output and alert bodies, which still emitted hyperlinks unconditionally.
Fixed a `=` character accumulating in the prompt every couple of seconds on terminals that do not implement the Kitty keyboard protocol, where the renderer's periodic re-arming of that protocol was printed as literal text instead of being interpreted.
Fixed `@` file path completion showing files that were in your `.antigravityignore`.
Fixed the artifact list showing a percent-escaped filename such as `quarterly%20plan.md` for artifacts whose name contains a space, so the list row, the inline preview and the detail header all spell the name the same way.
Fixed the prompt editor's cursor becoming misaligned when text wrapped.
Fixed the `/mcp` panel dropping `enabledTools`, `timeoutSeconds`, `url` and `tools.eager` from `mcp_config.json` when you toggled a server on or off; it now preserves any field it does not recognize, so configuration written by a newer client survives an edit.
Fixed `read_resource` discarding non-image binary content returned by an MCP server, which now offloads every blob to disk and inlines only small text and image resources, so large PDFs, audio and other binary resources are usable instead of silently dropped.
Fixed Workforce Identity Federation sign-in signing you out roughly every hour, because the token refresh went to the standard sign-in endpoint rather than the federated one.
Fixed skills that ship with the CLI being reported as not built-in, so the `builtin` flag in the `/skills` listing under `--output-format json` is accurate and the `/skills` panel groups them correctly.
Fixed the reasoning-effort description under the timeline gauge in the `/effort` and `/model` pickers overflowing on narrow terminals, where it is now omitted so the gauge stays readable.
Fixed `/btw` failing with a planner configuration error in conversations driven by a custom or SDK-defined agent, so side questions work regardless of which agent you are running.
Fixed a failed `/btw` side question always reporting `model returned an empty response`, which was a hardcoded guess rather than the real failure; the card now shows the side question's own error when there is one.
Fixed the status line, the active-items list and the `/tasks` panel continuing to show background tasks that had already finished.
Fixed the CLI overwriting a `settings.json` it could not parse with default settings, which silently reverted every setting the next time anything was saved; a refused save now leaves the file byte-identical so you can repair it by hand, and the status line names the file.
Fixed a subagent whose definition leaves `model` at `inherit` failing to start when the parent agent has no model of its own, which now falls back to the default fast tier.

title.zh-TW: 串流輸入、規則管理與登入修復
title.zh-CN: 流式输入、规则管理与登录修复
title.en: Streaming input, rules, and sign-in fixes
title.ja: ストリーム入力、ルール、サインイン修正
title.ko: 스트리밍 입력, 규칙 및 로그인 수정

body.zh-TW: 新增 stream-json 對話輸入與代理、外掛規則設定，並修正啟動、憑證、計費層級、額度提示及終端互動問題。
body.zh-CN: 新增 stream-json 对话输入与代理、插件规则设置，并修复启动、凭据、计费层级、额度提示及终端交互问题。
body.en: Adds stream-json conversations and agent/plugin rule configuration, and fixes startup, credential, billing-tier, credit-message, and terminal interaction problems.
body.ja: stream-json 会話入力とエージェント／プラグインのルール設定を追加し、起動、認証情報、課金区分、クレジット表示、端末操作の問題を修正しました。
body.ko: stream-json 대화 입력과 에이전트/플러그인 규칙 설정을 추가하고 시작, 자격 증명, 요금제, 크레딧 표시 및 터미널 상호작용 문제를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
Added `--input-format stream-json` to print mode, which reads newline-delimited JSON prompts from stdin and runs one turn per message in a single conversation, so a driver can keep a session open.
Added a `rules:` key to markdown agent frontmatter, so an agent can name rule files directly instead of inheriting your whole rule tree; a rule named this way always applies.
Added plugin support for a top-level `rules.json`, so a plugin can declare the rule files it ships the same way it already declares its skills.
Added a more specific hint on the spinner line, which now names the tool call the agent is currently running.
Fixed the CLI aborting at startup on hosts that preload their own allocator through `LD_PRELOAD`, such as Cloud TPU VM images, where it died before the interface appeared.
Fixed personal accounts hitting a resource-exhausted error at startup when saved credentials were restored from the system keyring, and cut the repeated account checks that followed.
Fixed your billing project, and the license tier it selects, being lost when the CLI restarted and restored saved credentials from the system keyring.
Fixed a spurious "Out of credits" message for enterprise users signed in through Application Default Credentials.
Fixed the `/model` picker cutting off models, and its own header, on terminals too short to show every model; the list now scrolls.
Fixed the `/model` picker misaligning its columns for model names that are not plain ASCII, by measuring column widths in display cells rather than bytes.
Fixed the spinner line flickering to a generic label between quick tool calls.
Fixed streamed text corrupting non-ASCII characters into replacement characters, in both the interactive display and `--output-format stream-json` text deltas.
Fixed artifacts written into a subdirectory of a conversation's artifact directory, such as `scratch/`, never appearing in the artifact list.
Fixed reading a `.wav` file failing as an unsupported media type, by normalizing non-canonical MIME types such as `audio/wave` before they reach the model.

title.zh-TW: 隱私遮罩、檔案權限與記憶體防護
title.zh-CN: 隐私遮罩、文件权限与内存防护
title.en: Privacy masking, file permissions, and memory safety
title.ja: プライバシー保護、ファイル権限、メモリ安全性
title.ko: 개인정보 마스킹, 파일 권한 및 메모리 안전

body.zh-TW: 讓專案名稱遮罩真正套用到整份分享檔案，將本機輸出改為僅擁有者可讀寫，並限制超大 JSONL 行，避免耗盡記憶體。
body.zh-CN: 让项目名称遮罩真正应用到整份分享文件，将本地输出改为仅所有者可读写，并限制超大 JSONL 行，避免耗尽内存。
body.en: Applies project-name masking to the entire shared file, makes local outputs owner-only, and caps oversized JSONL lines to prevent memory exhaustion.
body.ja: プロジェクト名のマスクを共有ファイル全体に適用し、ローカル出力を所有者専用に変更。巨大な JSONL 行によるメモリ枯渇を防止しました。
body.ko: 프로젝트 이름 마스킹을 전체 공유 파일에 적용하고 로컬 출력 권한을 소유자 전용으로 변경했으며 과도한 JSONL 줄로 인한 메모리 고갈을 방지했습니다.

items.original:
**The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire shared file.** An exported HTML report previously still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, so masking hid the names on screen without removing them from the file. The unmasked copy is now dropped from the export. If you shared a masked report from an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.
**The donut legend and project-naming insights are covered by the mask as well.** Both previously kept showing real project names; insights now read `Project N`, matching the numbering already used by the project table.
**Local files are created with owner-only permissions.** Attachments, exported reports and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/` and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were created with permissions that allowed other local accounts on the same machine to read them. New files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Attachment import no longer copies the source file's permissions along with the file.
**The quarantine directory is created with an explicit mode.** Files moved into it already kept owner-only permissions; the directory itself did not.
**An oversized line in a JSONL history file no longer exhausts memory.** Lines are read against a 64 MiB ceiling, set from a measured 23 MB real-world maximum, and skipped cleanly when they exceed it. Deeply nested JSON that raises `RecursionError` is treated as an invalid line.

body.en: Fixes percentage noise, Windows tray values, and update notifications; improves mobile navigation and anchors; and refreshes theme counts, social previews, and multilingual docs.
body.ja: 割合表示の誤差、Windows トレイ値、更新通知を修正し、モバイルナビと共有アンカーを改善。テーマ数、SNS プレビュー、多言語文書も更新しました。
body.ko: 백분율 노이즈, Windows 트레이 값과 업데이트 알림을 수정하고 모바일 탐색과 공유 앵커를 개선했으며 테마 수, 소셜 미리보기 및 다국어 문서를 갱신했습니다.

items.original:
**`usage status` no longer prints floating-point noise in percentages.** Session and weekly percentages were interpolated straight into the string, so a value like 42.30000000000001 could appear instead of 42.3. Both are now formatted to one decimal place.
**The Windows tray tooltip shows the same numbers as the panel, and no longer omits Antigravity.** It displayed *remaining* percent (100 minus used) while every panel shows *used* percent; the tooltip now matches, and adds its own Antigravity line when that card isn't hidden. The Claude line was also reformatted to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.
**Windows update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** The GitHub Release body's `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` markers rendered literally in the update dialog; macOS fixed this in 0.29.28 but the fix never reached Windows. Both platforms now share the same formatter.
**The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).
**The website's theme count was corrected from 12 to 13** — Catppuccin, shipped in 0.29.23, wasn't being counted — across all five languages.
**The social preview image reflects Windows support and reuses the site's own visuals.** It used to say "macOS Menu Bar App"; the new 1200×630 image pairs the brand and title with an actual panel screenshot (Claude, Codex, Antigravity) in the site's own colors, and dropped from 573KB to 96KB.
**README status-line screenshots are now recorded animations**, one per language instead of borrowed from English, made legible at README width.
**Status-line setup is now its own README section** instead of a subsection buried under Windows Support, so macOS users don't skip it, with terminology filled in for both platforms and Traditional Chinese.

body.zh-TW: 卡片超過 90% 時加入動態紅色警示，進度條標示 80% 門檻，並修正閒置後速率顯示、數字對齊與鍵盤焦點。
body.zh-CN: 卡片超过 90% 时加入动态红色警示，进度条标示 80% 门槛，并修复闲置后速率显示、数字对齐与键盘焦点。
body.en: Adds animated warnings above 90% and an 80% threshold marker, while fixing idle-rate display, numeric alignment, and keyboard focus.
body.ja: 90% 超で動く警告、80% のしきい値表示を追加し、アイドル後のレート表示、数値の整列、キーボードフォーカスを修正しました。
body.ko: 90% 초과 시 애니메이션 경고와 80% 임계 표시를 추가하고 유휴 후 사용률, 숫자 정렬 및 키보드 포커스를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
**Cards trace a warning light around their border at 90%.** When a Session or weekly row crosses 90%, a red arc travels around that card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, on the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards alike. The Default panel carries it today; other panels are unchanged.
**Progress tracks now mark the 80% threshold.** A tick sits where the bar turns red, so how much headroom is left reads at a glance instead of only from the percentage text.
**The rate label now falls back after you stop working.** Burn rate divided by the span between the first and last usage entry, which left idle time out of the denominator — a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. It now divides by the time elapsed since the first entry, so the rate decays while you are away. Thresholds and the cache-read exclusion are unchanged.
**Numeric readouts line up.** Project token counts, costs, and percentages use tabular figures, so the columns stop shifting as the digits change.
**Keyboard focus is visible on the Default panel**, and its buttons now animate between hover states instead of snapping. Both respect the system's reduced-motion setting.

title.zh-TW: 用名稱改 Project 項目，清單欄位也看得到名字
title.zh-CN: 用名称改 Project 项目，清单字段也看得到名字
title.en: Edit Project items by name and see named fields in lists
title.ja: 名前で Project 項目を編集し、一覧で名前付きフィールドを表示
title.ko: 이름으로 Project 항목을 고치고 목록에서 이름 있는 필드를 본다

body.zh-TW: 你在 GitHub Project（把工作拆成卡片和欄位的管理看板）裡找待辦事項，不必先翻出那串難記的 ID 了。`gh project item-edit` 現在能依名稱找到項目；像整理「修登入頁」這張卡時，可直接用它的名字指定對象。`gh project item-list` 也能把具名欄位列出來，清單不再只像一排沒有標籤的抽屜。搜尋某個儲存庫時，`gh search --repo` 會提示 `OWNER/REPO` 格式，文件也把依名稱編輯列為主要做法。
body.zh-CN: 你在 GitHub Project（把工作拆成卡片和字段的管理看板）里找待办事项，不必先翻出那串难记的 ID 了。`gh project item-edit` 现在能按名称找到项目；比如整理“修登录页”这张卡时，可直接用它的名字指定对象。`gh project item-list` 也能列出具名字段，清单不再只像一排没有标签的抽屉。搜索某个仓库时，`gh search --repo` 会提示 `OWNER/REPO` 格式，文档也把按名称编辑列为主要做法。
body.en: When you are looking for a task in a GitHub Project, you no longer have to dig up its hard-to-remember ID first. `gh project item-edit` can now resolve an item by name, so you can target a card such as “Fix login page” by its name. `gh project item-list` can show named field columns too, rather than a row of unlabeled drawers. `gh search --repo` now hints at the `OWNER/REPO` format, and the docs present name-based editing as the main Project flow.
body.ja: GitHub Project でタスクを探すとき、覚えにくい ID を先に掘り出さなくてよくなった。`gh project item-edit` は項目名から対象を解決できるため、「ログイン画面を直す」のようなカードを名前で指定できる。`gh project item-list` では名前付きフィールドの列も表示でき、一覧がラベルのない引き出しの列ではなくなる。`gh search --repo` には `OWNER/REPO` 形式のヒントが出て、文書も名前での編集を中心の手順として示す。
body.ko: GitHub Project에서 할 일을 찾을 때 외우기 힘든 ID부터 꺼내 볼 필요가 없어졌다. `gh project item-edit`가 이제 이름으로 항목을 찾아 주므로 “로그인 페이지 고치기” 같은 카드를 이름으로 지정할 수 있다. `gh project item-list`는 이름 붙은 필드 열도 보여 주어 목록이 라벨 없는 서랍 줄처럼 보이지 않는다. `gh search --repo`에는 `OWNER/REPO` 형식 힌트가 나오고, 문서도 이름으로 편집하는 흐름을 중심으로 안내한다.

title.zh-TW: `gh skill` 接上 Grok，代理清單換成 Devin
title.zh-CN: `gh skill` 接上 Grok，代理列表换成 Devin
title.en: `gh skill` adds Grok and swaps Windsurf for Devin
title.ja: `gh skill` が Grok に対応し、Windsurf を Devin に差し替え
title.ko: `gh skill`이 Grok을 지원하고 Windsurf 대신 Devin을 쓴다

body.zh-TW: 想讓 AI 代理幫忙檢視程式碼時，`gh skill` 的選項更新了。它新增 Grok 的 skill host 支援，也把代理清單中的 Windsurf 換成 Devin；選擇畫面過長的標籤換行問題一併修好。專案還加入 code review agent skill，也就是給代理做程式碼審查用的操作說明。像替工具箱添了新轉接頭，現在能接 Grok；舊的 Windsurf 插槽則改標 Devin，拿取時不會再被斷行的標籤絆住。
body.zh-CN: 想让 AI 代理帮忙检查代码时，`gh skill` 的选项更新了。它新增 Grok 的 skill host 支持，也把代理列表中的 Windsurf 换成 Devin；选择画面过长的标签换行问题一并修好。项目还加入 code review agent skill，也就是给代理做代码审查用的操作说明。像给工具箱添了新转接头，现在能接 Grok；旧的 Windsurf 插槽则改标 Devin，拿取时不会再被断行的标签绊住。
body.en: If you use AI agents to review code, `gh skill` has refreshed its choices. It adds support for Grok as a skill host and replaces Windsurf with Devin in its agent list; labels that wrapped awkwardly in the picker have also been fixed. The project now includes a code-review agent skill: instructions for an agent doing code review. Think of a toolbox gaining a new adapter for Grok while the old Windsurf slot is relabeled Devin, with no wrapped label getting in the way.
body.ja: AI エージェントにコードレビューを頼むなら、`gh skill` の選択肢が更新された。Grok を skill host として使えるようになり、エージェント一覧の Windsurf は Devin に置き換わった。選択画面で長いラベルが不自然に折り返す問題も直っている。プロジェクトには、コードレビューを行うエージェント向けの手順である code review agent skill も加わった。工具箱に Grok 用の新しい変換アダプターを足し、Windsurf の差込口を Devin と書き換えたような変更である。
body.ko: AI 에이전트에게 코드 검토를 맡긴다면 `gh skill`의 선택지가 바뀌었다. Grok을 skill host로 지원하고 에이전트 목록의 Windsurf는 Devin으로 교체했다. 선택기에서 긴 라벨이 어색하게 줄바꿈되던 문제도 고쳤다. 프로젝트에는 코드 검토를 하는 에이전트용 지침인 code review agent skill도 추가했다. 공구 상자에 Grok용 새 어댑터를 넣고 Windsurf 칸의 이름을 Devin으로 바꾼 셈이며, 줄바꿈된 라벨이 선택을 방해하지 않는다.

title.ko: 검증 루트가 없어도 멈추지 않고 macOS 잠금 해제는 1분 기다린다

body.zh-TW: 開啟 GitHub CLI 時，驗證器需要的 trusted root（用來確認信任鏈起點的根憑證）若缺失，初始化失敗現在會被妥善處理，不會讓這一步變成死結。macOS 的 keyring（存放登入金鑰的地方）若跳出互動式解鎖提示，等待時間也從 3 秒延到 60 秒。這版還補上 macOS keyring 的安全文件。像進大樓時保全發現名冊少一頁，會改走可處理的流程；而你正翻包找門禁卡，櫃台願意多等一分鐘。
body.zh-CN: 打开 GitHub CLI 时，验证器需要的 trusted root（用来确认信任链起点的根证书）若缺失，初始化失败现在会被妥善处理，不会让这一步变成死结。macOS 的 keyring（存放登录密钥的地方）若弹出交互式解锁提示，等待时间也从 3 秒延到 60 秒。这版还补上 macOS keyring 的安全文档。像进大楼时保安发现名册少一页，会改走可处理的流程；而你正翻包找门禁卡，前台愿意多等一分钟。
body.en: When GitHub CLI starts, verifier initialization can fail because a trusted root—the root certificate at the start of a chain of trust—is missing. That failure is now handled gracefully instead of becoming a dead end. On macOS, an interactive keyring access prompt now gets 60 seconds rather than 3 seconds. This release also adds security documentation for the macOS keyring. It is like a guard finding a page missing from a visitor list and following a workable procedure, while the desk gives you a full minute to find your access card.
body.ja: GitHub CLI の起動時、信頼の連鎖の起点となる root certificate である trusted root が欠け、検証器の初期化に失敗することがある。この失敗は今、行き止まりにせず適切に処理される。macOS では keyring の対話式解錠プロンプトを待つ時間が 3 秒から 60 秒になった。macOS keyring の安全に関する文書も加わった。来客名簿の一頁が欠けていても警備員が対応手順へ進み、入館カードを探す人を受付が一分待つような変更である。
body.ko: GitHub CLI를 열 때 신뢰 사슬의 시작점인 root certificate, 즉 trusted root가 없어서 검증기 초기화가 실패할 수 있다. 이제 이 실패를 막다른 길로 만들지 않고 처리한다. macOS에서는 keyring의 대화형 잠금 해제 요청을 3초 대신 60초 기다린다. macOS keyring 보안 문서도 추가했다. 방문자 명단 한 장이 없어도 경비원이 처리 절차로 넘어가고, 출입 카드를 찾는 사람을 안내 데스크가 1분 기다려 주는 변화와 같다.

title.zh-TW: 專案自動流程整理：分流 issue、部署與依賴更新
title.zh-CN: 项目自动流程整理：分流 issue、部署与依赖更新
title.en: Project automation tidied: issue triage, deployment, and dependency updates
title.ja: プロジェクト自動化を整理：issue 分類、デプロイ、依存関係更新
title.ko: 프로젝트 자동화를 정리했다: issue 분류, 배포, 의존성 업데이트

body.zh-TW: 這張卡講的是 gh 專案自己的後勤，不是你今天要輸入的新指令。團隊新增 pull request 範本、用代理分流 issue 的 workflow，也新增 Dependabot 的分流流程；issue 分流 workflow 改用 Actions token 做 Copilot 推論，並更新到 gh-aw v0.83.1。部署 workflow 加強，網站部署用的 `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` 改由 gh-cli-site-deployer App 取代。CodeQL 的 Dependabot 更新會分組處理，Go 與多個函式庫、Actions 也陸續升版；無效的 CODEOWNERS 規則與程式、文件、註解的錯字一併清掉。像倉庫後場重新排班：分貨、交接、補貨都各自有路走，前台的 CLI 使用方式沒有因此多一道手續。
body.zh-CN: 这张卡讲的是 gh 项目自己的后勤，不是你今天要输入的新命令。团队新增 pull request 模板、用代理分流 issue 的 workflow，也新增 Dependabot 的分流流程；issue 分流 workflow 改用 Actions token 做 Copilot 推理，并更新到 gh-aw v0.83.1。部署 workflow 加强，网站部署用的 `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` 改由 gh-cli-site-deployer App 取代。CodeQL 的 Dependabot 更新会分组处理，Go 与多个函数库、Actions 也陆续升级；无效的 CODEOWNERS 规则与代码、文档、注释的错字一并清掉。像仓库后场重新排班：分货、交接、补货都各自有路走，前台的 CLI 使用方式没有因此多一道手续。
body.en: This card is about the gh project's own backstage work, not a new command for you to type today. The team adds a pull-request template, an agentic issue-triage workflow, and a Dependabot-triage workflow; the issue-triage workflow uses the Actions token for Copilot inference and is refreshed to gh-aw v0.83.1. The deployment workflow is hardened, and `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` is replaced by the gh-cli-site-deployer App. CodeQL Dependabot updates are grouped, while Go, libraries, and Actions receive updates; a dead CODEOWNERS rule and typos in code, docs, and comments are removed. It is like reorganizing a warehouse back room: sorting, handoffs, and restocking each get their own route, without adding a step to the CLI counter.
body.ja: このカードは、今日入力する新コマンドではなく gh プロジェクト自身の裏方作業である。pull request テンプレート、エージェントによる issue 分類 workflow、Dependabot 分類 workflow を加え、issue 分類 workflow は Copilot 推論に Actions token を使い、gh-aw v0.83.1 へ更新した。デプロイ workflow も強化し、`SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` は gh-cli-site-deployer App に置き換えた。CodeQL の Dependabot 更新はまとめて処理し、Go、複数のライブラリー、Actions を更新する。無効な CODEOWNERS 規則と、コード、文書、コメントの誤字も削った。倉庫の裏方を組み直し、仕分け、引き継ぎ、補充にそれぞれ道を作るような変更である。
body.ko: 이 카드는 오늘 입력할 새 명령어가 아니라 gh 프로젝트의 뒷일에 관한 내용이다. pull request 템플릿, 에이전트 기반 issue 분류 workflow, Dependabot 분류 workflow를 추가했다. issue 분류 workflow는 Copilot 추론에 Actions token을 쓰고 gh-aw v0.83.1로 갱신했다. 배포 workflow도 강화했으며 `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT`는 gh-cli-site-deployer App으로 교체했다. CodeQL Dependabot 업데이트는 묶어서 처리하고 Go, 여러 라이브러리, Actions도 업데이트한다. 쓸모없는 CODEOWNERS 규칙과 코드, 문서, 주석의 오타도 지웠다. 창고 뒷편을 다시 배치해 분류, 인계, 보충마다 길을 따로 만든 변화와 같다.

title.zh-TW: 免登入下載公開專案的發布檔
title.zh-CN: 免登录下载公开项目的发布档
title.en: Download public releases without authentication
title.ja: ログイン不要で公開プロジェクトのリリースをダウンロード
title.ko: 로그인 없이 공개 프로젝트 배포 파일 다운로드

body.zh-TW: 你是不是常在沒有登入帳號的乾淨電腦上，只想快速下載某個公開專案的安裝檔，卻被登入提示卡住？以往即使你想抓取的軟體是放在完全公開的專案中，執行命令時，系統還是會硬性要求進行 authentication（驗證程序，確認使用者身分的程序）才能下載。現在這個不方便的門檻被移除了，只要是公開專案，任何人都可以免登入直接把發布檔抓下來。這就像走進免費開放的市立圖書館拿一份導覽手冊，以前警衛還會擋在門口硬要你掏出借書證來登記，現在只要是公開擺在架上的東西，你推開門就能直接拿走。當你在新主機上需要快速抓取公開安裝檔時，這正是你輸入 `gh release download` 的時刻，保證一路暢通。
body.zh-CN: 你是不是常在没有登录账号的干净电脑上，只想快速下载某个公开项目的安装包，却被登录提示卡住？以往即使你想抓取的软件是放在完全公开的项目中，运行命令时，系统还是会硬性要求进行 authentication（验证程序，确认用户身份的程序）才能下载。现在这个不方便的门槛被移除了，只要是公开项目，任何人都可以免登录直接把发布文件抓下来。这就像走进免费开放的市立图书馆拿一份导览手册，以前警卫还会挡在门口硬要你掏出借书证来登记，现在只要是公开摆在架上的东西，你推开门就能直接拿走。当你在新主机上需要快速抓取公开安装包时，这正是你运行 `gh release download` 的时候，保证一路畅通。
body.en: Have you ever tried to quickly fetch a release installer from a public repository on a clean system, only to be blocked by login prompts? Previously, even when a tool was hosted in a completely public project, trying to grab it would trigger a mandatory authentication (verification process confirming your identity) flow. We have now removed this hurdle, allowing anonymous access to all public releases. It is like walking into a public library to grab a brochure: the guard used to stubbornly demand your library card just to take a free leaflet, but now you can just walk in and take it. When you need to fetch a public installer on a new machine, that is when to run `gh release download` and download it without any hassle.
body.ja: アカウント設定をしていない綺麗な PC から、公開プロジェクトのリリースファイルを急いで取得しようとして、ログイン画面に邪魔されたことはないだろうか。以前は、対象のプロジェクトが誰にでも開かれているものであっても、コマンド実行時に authentication（認証、本人であることを確認する手続き）が強制された。今回この不便な制限が解除され、公開リポジトリのリリースは誰でもログインなしで保存できるようになった。図書館で例えれば、案内パンフレットを1枚もらうだけで図書カードの提示を求めてきた警備員がいなくなり、棚から自由に持ち帰れるようになったようなものである。新規サーバーで公開リリースを入手したいときこそ、`gh release download` を実行する瞬間である。
body.ko: 로그인을 안 한 새 컴퓨터에서 공개 프로젝트의 릴리스 파일만 빠르게 받고 싶은데 로그인 창이 나타나 막혔던 적이 있는가? 이전에는 해당 도구가 공개된 저장소에 있더라도 명령어를 쓸 때 authentication(인증, 본인 확인을 거치는 절차)이 필수로 요구됐다. 이제 이 문턱이 사라져서 공개된 프로젝트라면 로그인 없이 누구나 배포 파일을 직접 가져올 수 있다. 도서관에서 안내 책자를 하나 집을 때 대출증을 확인하던 경비원이 없어져 누구나 자유롭게 들고 갈 수 있게 된 것과 같다. 새 장비에서 공개 설치 파일을 즉시 받아야 할 때가 바로 `gh release download`를 실행할 순간이다.

items.original: Allow `gh release download` without authentication on public repositories by @BagToad in [#13723](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13723)

title.ko: 더 많은 AI 에이전트 지원 및 똑똑해진 스킬 설치

body.zh-TW: 你正在為 AI 代理工具配置新的擴充能力，卻因為指令一直彈出不必要的提問而感到心煩？這次更新擴大了支援，讓 `gh skill` 指令能自動偵測更多第三方的 coding agents（寫程式碼代理，能協助撰寫程式碼的 AI 助手），並完整支援 `antigravity-cli` 與 `antigravity2.0`。此外，通用技能的預設安裝路徑也更正為 `~/.agents/skills`；更棒的是，如果你已經指定了安裝目錄參數，系統就不會再彈出冗餘的 prompt（互動提示，指程式在終端機中要求使用者輸入或選擇的畫面），會直接遵守你的選擇。這就像買了一支萬用遙控器，它學會了最新電視的頻率，而且當你指著電視按開關時，它不會再跳出選單囉唆地問你要遙控哪台設備。當你想自訂路徑且不想被打擾，這正是你使用 `gh skill` 指令的時刻。
body.zh-CN: 你正在为 AI 代理工具配置新的扩充能力，却因为指令一直弹出不必要的提问而感到心烦？这次更新扩大了支持，让 `gh skill` 指令能自动侦测更多第三方的 coding agents（写代码代理，能协助撰写代码的 AI 助手），并完整支持 `antigravity-cli` 与 `antigravity2.0`。此外，通用技能的默认安装路径也更正为 `~/.agents/skills`；更棒的是，如果你已经指定了安装目录参数，系统就不会再弹出冗余的 prompt（互动提示，指程序在终端中要求用户输入或选择的画面），会直接尊重你的选择。这就像买了一支万能遥控器，它学会了最新电视的频率，而且当你指着电视按开关时，它不会再弹出菜单啰唆地问你要遥控哪台设备。当你想自定义路径且不想被打扰，这正是你使用 `gh skill` 指令的时候。
body.en: Are you setting up custom capabilities for your AI helper, only to be annoyed by redundant terminal questions? This update expands the reach of the `gh skill` command to detect more third-party coding agents (AI assistants that help you write code) and officially support `antigravity-cli` and `antigravity2.0`. Under the hood, universal skills are now correctly routed to `~/.agents/skills`. Best of all, if you specify the installation path directly, the system will honor it without prompting (asking questions via terminal menu dialogs). It is like using a universal remote that supports the latest TVs; when you point it at the screen and press power, it no longer pops up a menu asking which device you wish to control. When you want a silent, customized install, that is when to run `gh skill`.
body.ja: AI アシスタントに新しい能力を追加したいのに、コマンドから余計な確認質問が何度も飛んできて煩わしく思ったことはないだろうか。今回 `gh skill` コマンドが拡張され、より多くのサードパーティ製 coding agents（コーディングエージェント、プログラムの記述を支援する AI 助手）を検出できるようになり、`antigravity-cli` と `antigravity2.0` にも対応した。また、スキルファイルの標準保存先が `~/.agents/skills` に修正された。何より、パラメータでフォルダを指定した際は、余計な prompt（プロンプト、操作を一時停止して回答を求める案内）を出さずに指示通り動くようになった。最新テレビに対応した万能リモコンのようなもので、電源を押したときに余計なメニュー画面が出なくなった。パスを直接指定して静かにインストールしたいときこそ、`gh skill` コマンドを実行する瞬間である。
body.ko: AI 조수에게 새로운 기능을 더해주려는데, 명령어에서 불필요한 질문을 자꾸 던져 답답했던 적이 있는가? 이번 변경으로 `gh skill` 명령어가 더 많은 coding agents(코딩 에이전트, 코드 작성을 돕는 AI 도우미)를 찾아내며, `antigravity-cli`와 `antigravity2.0`도 공식 지원한다. 또한 공용 스킬의 기본 설치 위치가 `~/.agents/skills`로 수정됐다. 무엇보다 경로 파라미터를 입력하면 불필요한 prompt(프롬프트, 화면에 선택 항목을 띄워 입력을 요구하는 안내) 창 없이 지시를 바로 따른다. 최신 TV 주파수를 배운 만능 리모컨 같아서, 전원을 누를 때 기기를 고르라는 잔소리를 하지 않는 셈이다. 경로를 직접 지정해 조용히 설치하고 싶을 때가 바로 `gh skill`을 입력할 순간이다.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Codespace 轉發當機與 CI 狀態空白
title.zh-CN: 修正 Codespace 转发死机与 CI 状态空白
title.en: Fixes for Codespace port forwarding crashes and blank CI summaries
title.ja: Codespace 転送時のクラッシュと CI 状態が空白になるバグを修正
title.ko: Codespace 포워딩 충돌 및 CI 상태가 빈 화면으로 뜨는 문제 해결

body.zh-TW: 你是否遇過雲端開發環境突然崩潰，或是自動化檢查被取消後，狀態欄只顯示一片空白？這次修復專門為這些不穩定的角落提供保護。首先，處理 codespace port forwarding（連接埠轉發，將雲端開發機器的網路連接埠導引至本機的傳輸技術）時，背後因 concurrent map writes（併發寫入衝突，指多個處理程序同時修改同一份內部資料造成的當機錯誤）導致連線崩潰的問題已解決。此外，當 CI checks（自動化檢查）被全部取消時，摘要畫面的空白已被老實顯示的取消通知取代。這就像餐廳裡兩個服務生同時往同個格子上寫點單，紙張撕破導致系統當機的問題被修好了；而且如果整桌退單，看板也會清楚寫明「已取消」而非留下一塊讓人瞎猜的空白黑板。
body.zh-CN: 你是否遇过云端开发环境突然崩溃，或是自动化检查被取消后，状态栏只显示一片空白？这次修复专门为这些不稳定的角落提供保护。首先，处理 codespace port forwarding（端口转发，将云端开发机器的网络端口引导至本机的传输技术）时，背后因 concurrent map writes（并发写入冲突，指多个处理程序同时修改同一份内部数据造成的死机错误）导致连线崩溃的问题已解决。此外，当 CI checks（自动化检查）被全部取消时，摘要画面的空白已被老实显示的取消通知取代。这就像餐厅里两个服务员同时往同个格子上写点单，纸张撕破导致系统死机的问题被修好了；而且如果整桌退单，看板也会清楚写明“已取消”而非留下一块让人瞎猜的空白黑板。
body.en: Have you ever had your cloud development environment crash, or been left guessing when cancelled automation runs showed nothing at all? We have hardened these fragile areas. We resolved a crash where codespace port forwarding (connecting network ports of a remote container to your local machine) failed due to concurrent map writes (a data collision error when multiple processes modify the same memory table simultaneously). Additionally, if CI checks (automated checks) are cancelled, the summary screen now reports the status instead of displaying a blank void. It's like a restaurant fixing a glitch where two waiters writing on the same order ticket caused a system crash, and ensuring that if a table cancels, the kitchen screen displays "Cancelled" instead of an empty black board.
body.ja: クラウドの開発環境で突然クラッシュしたり、自動テストのキャンセル後に進捗表示が真っ白になって困ったことはないだろうか。今回の修正で、codespace port forwarding（ポート転送、クラウド環境の通信ポートを手元の端末と繋ぐ機能）の並行処理において、concurrent map writes（メモリ同時書き込み衝突、複数の処理が同じデータを同時に変更しようとするクラッシュ）が発生するバグを解消した。また、CI checks（自動チェック）がすべて中止された際も、要約画面に空白結果の表示ではなく事実を表示する。ウェイターが注文票を同時に書き換えてシステムが落ちる問題を解決し、注文が消えたら「取消」と黒板に明記するようにしたようなものである。
body.ko: 클라우드 개발 환경이 갑자기 충돌하거나, 자동 테스트 취소 후 상태 창이 텅 비어 답답했던 적이 있는가? 이번 패치는 이런 불안정한 오작동을 해결했다. codespace port forwarding(포트 포워딩, 원격 컨테이너의 포트를 내 컴퓨터로 연결해 주는 기술) 중 concurrent map writes(동시 쓰기 충돌, 여러 프로세스가 메모리 공간을 동시에 고치려다 죽는 현상)로 다운되던 문제를 잡았다. 또한 CI checks(자동 검사)가 취소됐을 때 결과 화면이 빈칸으로 남는 대신 취소 상태를 보여준다. 식당에서 주문서에 주문을 동시에 적다 종이가 찢겨 나가던 오류를 잡고, 손님이 주문을 물렸을 때 칠판을 비워두지 않고 '취소됨'이라고 확실히 적어두는 것과 같다.

title.zh-TW: 資料庫識別碼升級與工作流安全性補強
title.zh-CN: 数据库识别码升级与工作流安全性补强
title.en: Database ID upgrades and workflow security reinforcement
title.ja: データベース識別子の拡張とワークフローのセキュリティ強化
title.ko: 데이터베이스 식별자 확장 및 워크플로 보안성 강화

body.zh-TW: 當專案資料庫的識別碼數量日益膨脹，或是自動化工作流面臨被惡意修改的安全風險？為了解決底層的潛在危機，系統在多處細節做出了補強。首先，將 database IDs（資料庫識別碼，用來標示每筆資料唯一身分的數字代號）的資料型態升級為更大的 64 位元整數，防止隨著 GitHub 資料量成長而溢位。同時，將可重複使用的 triage workflows（工作流，特定事件觸發時自動執行的指令腳本）固定在特定的 commit SHA，防止工作流遭到篡改，並在說明中澄清了複製指令的行為。這就像將倉庫的舊鎖頭升級，把不夠大的抽屜換成超大保險櫃，並對自動門鎖裝上硬體鎖定，不管資料如何成長或外部如何變化，系統都能牢牢守護一切，不再因老舊漏洞而動搖。
body.zh-CN: 当项目数据库的识别码数量日益膨胀，或是自动化工作流面临被恶意修改的安全风险？为了解决底层的潜在危机，系统在多处细节做出了补强。首先，将 database IDs（数据库识别码，用来标示每笔数据唯一身份的数字代号）的数据类型升级为更大的 64 位整数，防止随着 GitHub 数据量增长而溢出。同时，将可重复使用的 triage workflows 固定在特定的 commit SHA，防止工作流遭到篡改，并在说明中澄清了复制指令的行为。这就像将仓库的旧锁头升级，把不够大的抽屉换成超大保险柜，并对自动门锁装上硬件锁定，不管数据如何增长或外部如何变化，系统都能牢牢守护一切，不再因旧漏洞而动摇。
body.en: Are you worried about database identifiers overflowing as records grow, or automated pipelines facing security threats from malicious changes? To address these underlying risks, we have reinforced several security and architectural details. The database IDs are now upgraded to 64-bit integers to prevent truncation on large data sets. Additionally, we pinned reusable triage workflows to a specific commit SHA to lock down their versions against unexpected alterations, and clarified command behavior in help files. It is like replacing shallow storage drawers with a giant vault and adding a physical lock to automated doors; the system stands secure and robust, unaffected by data growth or external tampering.
body.ja: データの増加に伴いデータベースの ID が溢れたり、自動化スクリプトが改ざんされるセキュリティリスクが気になったことはないだろうか。これらのリスクに対処するため、内部構造を強化した。まず、各レコードを一意に識別する database IDs（データベース識別子、データの識別番号）を 64 ビット整数に引き上げ、巨大なデータ量でも溢れないようにした。さらに、再利用可能な triage workflows（ワークフロー）を特定の commit SHA で固定し、予期せぬ改変を防ぐ対策を行い、ヘルプの説明も分かりやすく改善した。引き出しを金庫に変え、自動ドアに物理的な鍵を後付けしたようなものであり、データ量が増えても安全にシステムが機能する。
body.ko: 레코드가 쌓이면서 데이터베이스 식별자가 넘칠까 봐 걱정되거나, 자동화 파이프라인이 임의로 조작되는 보안 위협을 느껴본 적이 있는가? 이번 변경으로 몇 가지 중요 부위를 정비했다. 먼저 데이터 레코드를 구분하는 database IDs(데이터베이스 식별자, 자료마다 붙는 고유 번호)의 유형을 64비트 정수로 바꿔서 GitHub 데이터가 커져도 데이터가 깨지지 않게 했다. 아울러 반복해서 쓰이는 triage workflows의 버전을 특정 commit SHA로 묶어 무단 수정되지 않도록 걸어 잠그고 도움말 문구도 가다듬었다. 수납함을 대형 금고로 업그레이드하고 자동문 장치에 수동식 자물쇠를 추가로 단 셈이다.

title.zh-TW: 說明文件優化與依賴套件版本升級
title.zh-CN: 帮助文档优化与依赖项版本升级
title.en: Documentation polish and dependency version updates
title.ja: ドキュメントの調整と依存パッケージの更新
title.ko: 도움말 문서 개선 및 라이브러리 의존성 업데이트

body.zh-TW: 你正在為專案尋找更多搜尋範例以提升開發效率，或者想讓部署流程跑得更穩定無誤？為了讓開發者使用更順暢，本次更新在搜尋文件補上了多個 qualifiers（限定符，用來過濾或精準匹配搜尋結果的修飾關鍵字）的實用範例，並修復了發布流程文件裡失效的 anchor link（錨點連結，指向網頁內特定段落的書籤連結）。同時，開發團隊也為多個內部依賴套件進行了版本升級。這就像重新繪製了大樓裡印錯的樓層指引招牌，並順手更換了多個老舊零件。這些微小的保養工作雖然不顯眼，卻能保證每位訪客都不會在大樓中迷路，也讓整座系統運作得更穩定安全。
body.zh-CN: 你正在为项目寻找更多搜索范例以提升开发效率，或者想让部署流程跑得更稳定无误？为了让开发者使用更顺畅，本次更新在搜索文档补上了多个 qualifiers（限定符，用来过滤或精准匹配搜索结果的修饰关键字）的实用范例，并修复了发布流程文档里失效的 anchor link（锚点链接，指向网页内特定段落的书签链接）。同时，开发团队也为多个内部依赖项进行了版本升级。这就像重新绘制了大楼里印错的楼层指引招牌，并顺手更换了多个老旧零件。这些微小的保养工作虽然不显眼，却能保证每位访客都不会在大楼中迷路，也让整个系统运行得更稳定安全。
body.en: Are you searching the documents for better query examples, or looking to keep your pipeline builds stable? To keep instructions clear, we added practical examples using multiple qualifiers and fixed a broken anchor link in the release guide. Additionally, several build and environment dependencies were updated. It is like fixing spelling mistakes on floor guide maps and swapping out standard elevator parts. Although these maintenance steps are small, they prevent visitors from getting lost and keep the whole building operating safely.
body.ja: ドキュメントから便利な検索例を探したり、ビルドやデプロイのプロセスを常に安定させたいと思ったことはないだろうか。利用時の混乱を防ぐため、複数の qualifiers（修飾子、検索結果を絞り込むためのキーワード）を指定する具体例を追加し、開発ガイド内のリンク切れしていた anchor link（アンカーリンク、ページ内の特定箇所へジャンプするしおり）を修復した。同時に、各種ツールやライブラリのバージョンも更新された。案内看板のスペルミスを直し、エレベーターの消耗品を交換するような作業である。地味な保守ではあるが、利用者の迷子を防ぎ、ビルド全体を安定させる。
body.ko: 문서에서 더 유용한 검색 예시를 찾고 있거나, 빌드와 배포 과정을 안정적으로 유지하고 싶은가? 사용상의 혼란을 방지하기 위해 여러 qualifiers(한정자, 검색 결과를 필터링하는 조건 키워드)를 조합한 구체적인 검색 예시를 추가하고, 개발 문서 내 끊어져 있던 anchor link(앵커 링크, 페이지의 특정 단락으로 바로 가는 책갈피)를 바로잡았다. 아울러 다수의 내부 라이브러리 의존성도 함께 업데이트했다. 건물의 층별 안내판에 오타를 고치고 엘리베이터의 낡은 부속품을 교체하는 일과 같다. 겉으로 드러나지 않는 소소한 정비이지만 사용자가 길을 잃지 않게 돕고 시스템 빌드 전체를 안정되게 굴려준다.
